official_apr_source.title: FY 2024 HHS Annual Performance Report
official_apr_source.publisher: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services
official_apr_source.evidence_location: printed page 88; PDF page index 87; web extraction lines 3331-3338
verified_text: Based on these reviews, each PDE in the audit sample is assigned a gross drug cost error.
A representative sample of beneficiaries undergoes a simulation to determine the Part D improper payment estimate.
web_verified_observations: CMS measures inconsistencies between PDE information and sponsor supporting documentation.
Each PDE in the audit sample is assigned a gross drug cost error.
A representative sample of beneficiaries undergoes a simulation to determine the Part D improper payment estimate.
official_apr_source.custody_attempt_result: The official HHS edge returned Akamai HTTP 403 responses to scripted requests on 2026-07-14, and a bounded headless-browser attempt did not yield the PDF.

supported_observations: The FY2024 Part D IPM reports CY2022 payments and attests compliance with OMB sampling and estimation-plan guidance and a statistically valid methodology.
The report publishes gross and net improper-payment estimates, the rate and denominator, and 95 percent confidence limits.
A corrected gross drug cost below the PDE value is classified as an overpayment error, while a corrected gross drug cost above the PDE value is classified as an underpayment.
captured_same_period_source.closure_limit: The findings report does not disclose the estimator formula or the mechanics that connect reviewed PDE errors and beneficiary simulation to the national estimate and confidence limits.

non_same_period_corroboration.title: Medicare Part D IPM Program Background
non_same_period_corroboration.observation: The current page describes applying PDE validation findings to a randomly selected 5 percent beneficiary sample and extrapolating to remaining beneficiary payments.
non_same_period_corroboration.use_rule: Current general corroboration only. Do not infer that the 5 percent design, extrapolation mechanics, or sample relationship governed CY2022/FY2024 without same-period evidence.

evidence_boundaries: Web extraction verifies text location and content but is not official binary custody.
Representative, simulation, statistically valid, and OMB-compliant do not disclose a reproducible estimator.
The 95 percent confidence interval is statistical uncertainty around the improper-payment estimate, not a recoverable-dollar range.
PDE gross drug cost error and projected overpayment are not automatically identified debt, collectibility, recovery, fraud, waste, prevention, or savings.
